scope: The extracted A081 configuration is device-specific evidence. SDK4.0.6 source explains reference transformations but its equivalence to the running A081 SXR binary is not established.

raw_qvr.coordinate_documentation: Android Portrait; SDK comment describes x up, y left, z toward user
raw_qvr.timestamp_current_external_mode: Exact submitted gyro CLOCK_BOOTTIME ns; IPC sample_monotonic_ns is the already bounded conversion when pose timestamp equals gyro timestamp. No extra native QTimer offset.
raw_qvr.quality: 0 bad /1 good in positional mode; TRACKING bit4 alone does not establish pose validity
raw_qvr.current_transport: 168-byte v1 unchanged; raw pose is diagnostic and has no Xr validity flag

a081_parameters.head_offset_source_description: Offset from center of eyes to IMU center; not a directly applicable Monado pose offset without matching stock coordinate semantics.
a081_parameters.observed_quality_kind: QVR header binary0/1; current actual records0. For future positive acceptance require1, do not weaken the existing gate to arbitrary fractional values.

sdk_reference_pipeline.operation: With prediction delay0, use raw quaternion/translation; prediction is a separate path.
Post-multiply sensor correction rotations in X thenY thenZ order; A081 config values above are allzero.

Convert quaternion to a matrix, transpose for the stated memory convention, populate the4x4 input with negated translation, then apply the display-orientation-specific conjugation. Keep matrix storage conventions explicit.

0/90 use the left correction branch;180/270 use right correction plus an extra180degree rotation. The270 branch also distinguishes pre24 Android from24+. The actual A081 activity rotation is not in current captures.
In positional mode only, add baseOffset - rotatedOffset using configured eye-to-IMU offset and recenter rotation.
Apply recenter rotation/position and native QTimer adjustment in the SDK consumer; current external-IMU BOOTTIME route must not repeat that offset.

SDK view builder consumes the returned quaternion directly as a view rotation; explicit camera-to-world helpers negate position and conjugate quaternion. This contradicts treating SXR-returned pose as an unqualified Monado device pose.
displayOrientation comes from the active Android Display.getRotation value. The default270 initialization is overwritten by JNI, so it is not A081 evidence.

unclosed_parameters: Actual A081 stock activity displayOrientation; panel pixel dimensions or current Monado viewport rotation are not a substitute.
Equivalence of the selected SDK reference transform to the shipped A081 SXR consumer.
Physical axis signs and handedness, world-to-device versus device-to-world transform, tracker/IMU/eye origin, and measured translation scale under real movement.
Favorable-scene positive raw quality1 with synchronized camera inputs and paired stock/public pose values.

runtime_recenter.operation: Existing Monado LOCAL and LOCAL_FLOOR yaw/ground-plane recenter; keeps y offset and sends reference-space-change events. Runtime requires an available valid relation.

next_acceptance.hardware_required: New explicit ready after device becomes visible; use the same authorized normal desktop session, not an extra display lifecycle.
next_acceptance.recenter: After actual orientation warmup, invoke same-prefix mix-xr-recenter once within current XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; preserve return code/reference-space events and LOCAL before/after. VIEW-fixed desktop remaining in place is expected. Keep normal first-exit buffer/fd capture.
next_acceptance.positive_6dof: Only after the exact remaining mapping parameters and actual positive quality/scale/motion evidence above are available.
